title: Name your ads so the account can be read like a table
hook: If an ad is named “Final_v3_new”, your account cannot teach you much six months from now.
caption:
If an ad is named “Final_v3_new”, your account cannot teach you much six months from now.

You will want to ask simple things. Do founder-led ads beat creator-led ones? Does a problem opening beat a product opening?

If the name does not say, someone has to rewatch every ad.

Use five fields in the same order every time: buyer, message, opening, cast, version. Keep a short list of allowed words for each.

Save the last slide and rename this week's live ads first. Follow @galvor.ai.

slides.headline: Name your ads so the account can be *read like a table*

slides.headline: “*Final_v3_new*” tells nobody what was tested
slides.body:
Six months on, you want to ask: do founder-led ads beat creator-led ones?

If the name does not say who is on screen, someone has to rewatch every ad to answer.

slides.headline: One name, *read left to right*
slides.body:
NewMum_SleepsThrough_Problem_Creator_v2

Anyone can read it without opening the ad. A filter on “Creator” or “Problem” now sorts the whole account.

items: A short list of allowed words per field
